name: The Origami Mooncake Festival
description: An autumn celebration where mooncakes are crafted from delicate origami paper in every color, floating above a traditional village as lanterns and paper cranes dance in the evening breeze.
prompt: A beautiful autumn festival scene with dozens of round origami mooncakes in vibrant colors floating gently above a traditional Asian village, delicate paper cranes and silk lanterns dancing in the evening breeze, warm amber street lights and glowing windows illuminating the scene, families gathering below, autumn leaves floating in the air, highly detailed, festive and heartwarming atmosphere, cultural fantasy art
caption: Celebrating with paper sweets under the harvest moon... 🥮🍂 What flavor would your folded treat be?
